policy.completeRule: A category is COMPLETE only when every required count/native-order check passes or is not applicable.
policy.incompleteRule: Any FAIL, UNKNOWN, or NOT_PROVEN result keeps the category INCOMPLETE.
policy.noInferenceRule: Missing indices, totals, final options, wrapping, and boundaries are not inferred from neighboring thumbnails or partial traversal.
